"""
VPIC-IO transformation plot: HDF5 Async + ZFP vs. Data Flyway (PDC ZFP).
One stacked bar per strategy at each rank count -- observed 4-step I/O time
(solid) + final outlier phase (hatched on top). Legend sits in the top-left
corner inside the axes.

Strategies (left to right within each group):
    HDF5 Async + ZFP        hard-coded below (from the original 40_vs_100 script)
    Data Flyway (PDC ZFP)   zfp_cpu/40_vs_100/vpic_zfp.csv (avg_40s, std_40s, outlier_40s)

Outputs (written to OUT_DIR):
    vpic_combined.pdf          full-width figure
    vpic_combined_narrow.pdf   single-column figure

Runs in Google Colab: mounts Google Drive and reads/writes under DRIVE_ROOT.
"""
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

from google.colab import drive

drive.mount("/content/drive")

# ── Drive locations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DRIVE_ROOT = "/content/drive/MyDrive/data-flyway-eval-plots"
CPU_CSV = f"{DRIVE_ROOT}/data/zfp_cpu/40_vs_100/vpic_zfp.csv"
OUT_DIR = f"{DRIVE_ROOT}/exps"

RANK_ORDER = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128]  # nodes, as stored in the data files
XTICK_LABELS = ["32", "64", "128", "256", "512", "1024", "2048", "4096"]  # MPI processes


# ── Loaders: each returns DataFrame(ranks, base, outlier) ────────────────────
def load_hdf5():
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "ranks":        [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128],
        "avg_data":     [0.000, 0.000, 0.000, 5.606, 11.862, 18.5, 27.674, 34.0],
        "avg_metadata": [7.837, 6.995, 7.781, 6.854, 3.593, 3.3, 3.171, 3.0],
        "outlier":      [28.601, 25.590, 25.564, 25.295, 25.005, 27.0, 28.048, 28.5],
    })
    df["base"] = (df["avg_data"] + df["avg_metadata"]) * 4
    return df[["ranks", "base", "outlier"]]


def load_cpu(compute_s):
    df = pd.read_csv(CPU_CSV)
    # Same formula as the original 40_vs_100 script: (avg + std) * 4.
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "ranks": df["ranks"],
        "base": (df[f"avg_{compute_s}s"] + df[f"std_{compute_s}s"]) * 4,
        "outlier": df[f"outlier_{compute_s}s"],
    })


# (label, color, loader)
SERIES = [
    ("HDF5 Async + ZFP", "#FF8F00", load_hdf5),
    ("Data Flyway", "#5C9BD6", lambda: load_cpu(40)),
]

LAYOUTS = {
    "wide": dict(suffix="", figsize=(16, 8), axis_fs=32, tick_fs=24, legend_fs=22,
                 group_width=0.7, outline_lw=1.5),
    "narrow": dict(suffix="_narrow", figsize=(6.0, 5.2), axis_fs=19, tick_fs=14, legend_fs=13,
                   group_width=0.75, outline_lw=0.8),
}
LEGEND_KW = dict(handlelength=2.0, handleheight=1.2, handletextpad=0.5)
Y_HEADROOM = 1.25  # extra space above the tallest bar so the legend never covers data


def build(data, L):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=L["figsize"], constrained_layout=True)
    n = len(data)
    slot = L["group_width"] / n
    bar_w = slot * 0.85
    x_of = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(RANK_ORDER)}
    ymax = 0.0

    for si, (label, color, df) in enumerate(data):
        offset = (si - (n - 1) / 2) * slot
        df = df[df["ranks"].isin(x_of)]
        x = np.array([x_of[r] for r in df["ranks"]]) + offset
        base = df["base"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        out = df["outlier"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        ymax = max(ymax, float(np.nanmax(base + out)))
        ax.bar(x, base, bar_w, color=color, linewidth=0, zorder=3)
        ax.bar(x, out, bar_w, bottom=base, facecolor=color, edgecolor="black",
               linewidth=0, hatch="///", zorder=3)
        ax.bar(x, base + out, bar_w, color="none", edgecolor="black",
               linewidth=L["outline_lw"], zorder=4)
        # Divider line between the solid 4-step part and the hatched outlier part.
        ax.bar(x, out, bar_w, bottom=base, color="none", edgecolor="black",
               linewidth=L["outline_lw"], zorder=4)

    ax.set_xlabel("Number of Processes", fontsize=L["axis_fs"])
    ax.set_ylabel("Observed I/O Time (s)", fontsize=L["axis_fs"])
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(RANK_ORDER)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(XTICK_LABELS, fontsize=L["tick_fs"])
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=L["tick_fs"])
    ax.set_xlim(-0.6, len(RANK_ORDER) - 0.4)
    ax.set_ylim(0, ymax * Y_HEADROOM)
    ax.grid(axis="y", linewidth=1.0, color="black", alpha=0.25)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

    # One swatch per strategy, plus a single swatch explaining the hatch.
    handles = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=c, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.8) for _, c, _ in data]
    labels = [lbl for lbl, _, _ in data]
    handles.append(mpatches.Patch(facecolor="white", edgecolor="black", hatch="///", linewidth=0.8))
    labels.append("Outlier phase (hatched)")
    leg = ax.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper left", ncol=1, fontsize=L["legend_fs"],
                    frameon=True, framealpha=1.0, edgecolor="black", **LEGEND_KW)
    leg.set_zorder(10)

    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"vpic_combined{L['suffix']}.pdf")
    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.1)
    print(f"Saved to {out_path}")
    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    data = [(label, color, loader()) for label, color, loader in SERIES]
    for L in LAYOUTS.values():
        build(data, L)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
